image_description: A group of four Brown Pelicans standing on a rocky surface near water. The pelicans have characteristic long bills with gular pouches, brownish-grey plumage on the body and wings, and yellowish-white heads and necks. The lighting is bright sunlight, casting strong shadows.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: All visible pelicans clearly display the massive bill structure with the distinctive hanging gular pouch attached to the lower mandible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Bill is enormous and elongated, vastly exceeding head length, with bright orange, yellow, or pink coloration during breeding.
